title: Thankful x Blessings
notes: hand arrangement (replaces the auto draft): Kodak's opening couplet (vox 4.75-6.8) over the beat's soft intro as the build into drop 1; verse 1 rides drop 1 and the first breakdown; drop 2 is Clementine's own hook; verse 2 runs over the beat's verse and second breakdown (vox bars 27.7-30.6 land in the breakdown); the instrumental peak at bar 89 stays instrumental; Clementine carries the last choruses; Kodak's spoken tag (vox 3-4.25) closes the outro
every Kodak clip edge sits in a measured gap between words (Whisper word timings)
bar numbers in these notes are Blessings' own bars, before the 16-bar DJ intro
stem arrangement on bed: verses over drums + bass (melodic layer -60 dB), full beat under hooks, 1 drums-only bar before each hook, melodic layer pumps on the beat
melodic layer by section: full in the intro, drops, and peak; -6 dB in both breakdowns under the rap; off under verse 2 and the bars after the second breakdown (drums + bass)
drop at bar 17: 1-bar build on bed-drums, bed-bass, bed-other, impact, 1 beat(s) of silence
drop at bar 41: 1-bar build on bed-drums, bed-bass, bed-other, impact, 1 beat(s) of silence
drop at bar 89: 1-bar build on bed-drums, bed-bass, bed-other, impact, 1 beat(s) of silence
fills: crash 17, crash 41, crash 89, crash 112.5
the beat's own 2-bar fade-out is cut; the DJ outro follows on
bar numbers in the notes above (and in fill ids like riser-92) are from before the DJ intro: add 16 to find them in this plan
DJ edges: 16-bar beat intro, 16-bar beat outro (looped from bar 17 of 01-calvin-harris-blessings)
QA round 1 (vocal presence below +7 dB): Kodak +3 dB (tag +5 dB), Clementine +3 dB, drums duck 6 dB under both vocals, outro drums -4 dB under the closing tag

QA round 2: closing tag +7 dB with the outro drums -8 dB and bass -4 dB under it; Clementine's flagged drop bars are her faint background chops (-26 to -41 dB in the stem), kept at the record's balance

QA round 3: spoken intro +7 dB (Whisper made out 9% of it; the source speaks it ~5 dB under the verse); Clementine reads 0% to Whisper here and on Calvin Harris's own master, so that is not a mix problem

clarity pass: Kodak's acapella re-separated at best quality and de-reverbed; density 0.75 and a 20 dB gate on his clips; drums duck 9 dB under Kodak (they are the beat's loudest 1-4 kHz part under the rap); melodic layer -6 dB under verse 1 on drop 1

v3: spoken intro removed (user); Blessings' intro trimmed by its first 8 bars, so plan bars from 25 on are 8 earlier than in the notes above (Blessings bar = plan bar - 8); verses use the dry chain with a light room instead of echo throws; no doubles on the closing tag
v3: closing tag removed too (user); the vocals end on Clementine, then the beat-only outro
v3 balance: Kodak +1.5 dB and drums duck 7 dB (the cleaner acapella reached about +20 dB presence, far past the +7 target, so level went back to the beat)

beat level pass: the cleaner acapella left Kodak at +6.2 LU over the beat where he raps, against -3.9 LU on his own record and -4.6 LU on Blessings; melodic layer back under the verses (-6 dB, -3 dB in the breakdowns, full on drop 1), drums duck 3 dB and melodic duck 4 dB

v6 tone: the chain had tripled Kodak's 2-5 kHz share (5.3% on his record, 14.3% in the mix) and sibilance (1.5% to 4.5%); density 0.25, a -4 dB shelf above 4.5 kHz, a 12 kHz low-pass, and room reverb 0.15 bring them to 10.4% and 1.8% for 2-3 points of Whisper clarity. Pitch correction can't make the verse more melodic: 0.2% of his rapped frames are steady sung notes

v7 hook: Thankful has no repeated line, so a pitched 'thankful' chop (B minor pentatonic, 3-3-2 rhythm, call and answer over 4 bars) gives the mix a short hook early and twice more: after the DJ intro, on the instrumental peak into Clementine's line, and in the outro
v7 hook levels: the chop source is spoken softly, so the hooks sit at +8 dB (intro), +15 dB (peak, with the drums ducked under it like the rap), and +12 dB (outro) to reach the verses' presence

v7 tuning: the chop word glides from about C3 down to E2 as spoken, so it comes from kodak-thankful-hook, a copy of the acapella with that one word flattened onto B2; the chop shifts then land on B, D, E, F#, and A

v8 hook: the pitched one-word chop read as no words at all (Whisper heard 'Outro Music' in it), so the hook is now a whole phrase in Kodak's own voice, 'see my blessings', named after the beat: twice after the DJ intro, three times on the instrumental peak with Clementine's line answering, twice in the outro
v8 hook treatment: Kodak's own voice with only a 120 Hz high-pass, no chain or echo; Whisper reads the raw slice as 'see my blessing' and the hook in the mix as '...my blessing'
